There is something so beautiful about watching young people be given the space to fully be themselves and embraced in the ever-expanding possibilities of what it means to be human. 🌈✨

Every child deserves the opportunity to explore their creativity, imagination, joy, and unique potential without shame or limitation. We are so grateful to be part of creating the kinds of spaces we wish existed growing up, and we can’t wait to see where this path leads. 

Thank you @bridgeschoolcooperative for hosting us and to @whitecenterpride for sponsorship the event!

Also big shout out to our photographer and videographer @jesse_sieden for capturing the magic!

posts.caption:
Today was a celebration of imagination and loving ourselves exactly as we are 🌈✨

We had such a beautiful time bringing Drag Story Time to @bridgeschoolcooperative alongside the incredible sponsorship of @whitecenterpride ! Together, we read stories, learned about the colors of the Pride flag, asked questions, danced, created art, and celebrated the magic that happens when young people are encouraged to show up fully as themselves. 

Watching these kiddos decorate their own flags, share their curiosity, and light up with confidence reminded us why this work matters so deeply. Inclusive literacy and creative spaces help build a future where every child knows they belong.

A huge thank you to The Bridge School for welcoming us so warmly into your community and to White Center Price for sponsoring the event. 💫

And this is just the beginning…

Drag Story Time is expanding into programming for ALL ages from schools and youth spaces to community organizations, workshops, creative gatherings, and intergenerational events.

If you’d like to bring Drag Story Time or inclusive arts programming to your organization, send us a DM! Tell us your goals, your community, and your vision and let’s create something beautiful together 🌈✨

#seattledrag #inclusiveliteracy #dragchurch #dragstorytime #seattle
